interest: Indexes US surveillance of Japanese activity in Brazil, including an alleged Amazon-republic plot and Bahia oil and power concessions.
overview: Docket for 894.20232, 1937-41: fifteen despatches on Japanese immigration, Paraíba colonization, Bahia oil and power concessions, an alleged Amazon-republic plot, Admiral Shinjiro Yamamoto's Catholic goodwill mission, Samurai-sword gifts to Brazilian military leaders, and Portuguese-language propaganda defending Japan's war in China.
